content_sections.heading: About Central Power Research Institute (CPRI)
content_sections.text: Central Power Research Institute (CPRI) is an autonomous society under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, engaged in research and development in generation, transmission, distribution and operation of electricity supply systems. CPRI acts as an apex body for applied research in electrical power engineering and serves as an independent authority for testing and certification of power equipment. Its head office is in Bangalore, with units at Bhopal, Hyderabad, Nagpur, Nashik, Noida, Kolkata, Guwahati and Raipur. CPRI Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CPRI Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: All educational qualifications must be from a University/Institution/Board recognized by the Government of India and/or approved by UGC/AICTE/State Government, as applicable. The minimum age to apply is 18 years. Age, qualification and category will be reckoned as on the closing date of the online application, i.e., 12.10.2026. Upper age limit is relaxable as per Government of India norms. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

rows.essential_qualification_experience: First Class Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering from a recognized university, with a valid GATE score of 2024/2025/2026 in Electrical Engineering
First Class Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Civil Engineering from a recognized university, with a valid GATE score of 2024/2025/2026 in Civil Engineering
First Class B.Sc. in Chemistry from a recognized university with 5 years of experience in the relevant subject field
First Class 3-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology in Electrical with 5 years of experience in the relevant field
First Class 3-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology in Mechanical with 5 years of experience in the relevant field
Matriculation or equivalent from a recognized Board; ITI Trade Certificate (2-year duration) in Electrical/Mechanical is desirable

First Class BA/B.Sc./B.Com/BBA/BBM/BCA degree from a recognized university, along with a minimum Grade-B certificate in the Basic Computer Course (BCC) conducted by NIELIT, valid as on the closing date of application. Only NIELIT BCC certificates are accepted; no other computer course is valid for this post
Matriculation or equivalent from a recognized Board (all posts reserved for Ex-servicemen)

faq.question: Q1. What is CPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CPRI Recruitment 2026 refers to Advertisement No. CPRI/06/2026 issued by Central Power Research Institute for filling 110 vacancies across Engineering Officer, Engineering Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Technician, Technical Attendant, Assistant Grade II and MTS Grade 1 posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 110 vacancies (provisional) are notified across 10 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 12.10.2026 at 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from Matriculation (Technical Attendant, MTS) to ITI Trade Certificate (Technician), Diploma (Engineering Assistant), Bachelor's Degree with GATE score (Engineering Officer), B.Sc. Chemistry (Scientific Assistant), and BA/B.Sc./B.Com/BBA/BBM/BCA with NIELIT BCC (Assistant Gr. II).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit ranges from 25 years (MTS Gr.1) to 35 years (Scientific Assistant, Engineering Assistant), with age relaxation as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1,000/- for Engineering Officer, Scientific Assistant and Engineering Assistant posts, and Rs. 700/- for Technician, Assistant Gr. II and Technical Attendant posts. SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen/women candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for CPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the CPRI official website, https://cpri.res.in/, by registering, filling the application form, uploading documents and paying the applicable fee before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on GATE score for Engineering Officer posts, and on a Computer Based Test (CBT) — combined with a skill test, trade test or proficiency test depending on the post — for all other posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for CPRI Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Level 1 (Rs. 18,000–56,900) for Technical Attendant and MTS posts to Level 7 (Rs. 44,900–1,42,400) for Engineering Officer posts, as per the 7th CPC pay matrix.
